steps.en: Clone, install with uv, and put model and Tavily keys in .env
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，用 uv 安装，把模型和 Tavily 的 key 写进 .env

steps.en: Start the local LangGraph server; Studio opens in the browser
steps.zh: 启动本地 LangGraph 服务，浏览器里打开 Studio

steps.en: Type a question in the messages field and submit
steps.zh: 在 messages 输入框里写下问题并提交

steps.en: Asks a clarifying question if needed, then writes a research brief
steps.zh: 必要时先问一个澄清问题，再写出调研简报

steps.en: A supervisor splits the brief and runs researcher sub-agents in parallel, each compressing its findings
steps.zh: 主管拆分简报，并行派出研究员子智能体，各自压缩发现

steps.en: Writes the final cited report from the compressed findings
steps.zh: 根据压缩后的发现写出带引用的最终报告

value.en: A working multi-agent research graph you can read, rewire and benchmark node by node
value.zh: 一张能跑的多智能体调研图，可以逐个节点阅读、改线、跑基准

sources: https://github.com/langchain-ai/open_deep_research#-quickstart (uv venv; uv sync; cp .env.example .env; uvx ... langgraph dev --allow-blocking; Studio UI; ask in the messages input field and click Submit)
